title: Resolution descent for degree-zero scalar-Hom compatibility
statement: If the normalized scalar-Hom zero-cycle compatibility holds for all direct complex representatives, then naturality of the zero-cycle equivalences and invariance under K-flat and K-injective resolutions transport it to arbitrary derived objects.

source.place: Tags 08JA and 079P; resolution and naturality descent

proof.text: Resolve each derived input by a complex representative, transport the scalar-Hom and section comparison maps through the derived units, and use naturality of the normalized zero-cycle equivalences to cancel the resolution isomorphisms.

mathlib_searches.query: transport derived category Hom equality across resolutions by naturality
mathlib_searches.results: Only abstract localization naturality; no specialized scalar-Hom zero-cycle descent.
Generic Q-map and derived naturality lemmas, no complete descent theorem.
